scope: SNU-Minnesota Korean implementation and ministry bridge actors

actors.name: 황영모

roles.role: Dean, College of Engineering, Seoul National University
roles.evidence: SNU Archives person record; AKS Encyclopedia

actions: documented as engineering dean in the Korean institutional leadership group working with chief adviser Arthur E. Schneider during project implementation
actors.attribution_limits: Do not infer that Hwang signed or approved the 1954 federal contract from his later implementation leadership.
open_leads: recover 1954-55 engineering college minutes and correspondence with Schneider
recover Hwang's U.S./Minnesota itinerary if he participated in dean observation travel
identify project requests signed by Hwang

actors.name: 조백현

roles.role: Dean, College of Agriculture, Seoul National University
roles.evidence: AKS Encyclopedia; Korea Scientists institutional biography

actions: documented as agriculture dean in the project implementation leadership group; institutional biographies connect his deanship to postwar agricultural-education reconstruction
actors.attribution_limits: Later biographies describing broad project contribution are not substitutes for contemporaneous approval or expenditure records.
open_leads: recover five-month U.S. observation itinerary and dates
recover agriculture-college project budgets and building/equipment requests
recover dean correspondence with FOA/ICA and Schneider

actors.name: 이제구

roles.role: Dean, College of Medicine, Seoul National University

actions: documented as medical dean in the Korean leadership group meeting/photographed with Schneider during early project implementation
actors.attribution_limits: Presence in the implementation leadership group does not establish a 1954 contract-signature or Korean governmental approval role.
open_leads: recover College of Medicine minutes on project scope and fellow selection
recover correspondence with Schneider and Minnesota medical advisers
identify successor dean and handover records after 1955

actors.name: 박철재

roles.role: Director-General, Technical Education Bureau, Ministry of Education

actions: served in the ministry's technical-education chain during the Minnesota project's launch period
actors.attribution_limits: A University of Minnesota archival photograph caption names an unidentified 'Dr. Park, Ministry of Education.' Park Cheol-jae is a plausible but unproven identity. Do not merge without photograph metadata, itinerary, or ministry correspondence.
open_leads: identify 'Dr. Park, Ministry of Education' in University of Minnesota photograph metadata
recover Park's 1954 U.S. technical-education inspection itinerary
search Ministry of Education technical-education files for SNU-Minnesota correspondence

actors.name: 이선근

roles.evidence: AKS Encyclopedia and consistent cabinet chronology

actions: KSP government study states the Korean side in early project-expansion negotiations included the Minister of Education, a Rehabilitation Ministry official, and the SNU president; chronology makes Lee the incumbent minister
actors.attribution_limits: The KSP text names the office, not Lee personally. The identity bridge is strong by tenure but the contemporaneous meeting minutes remain required before attributing a specific statement or decision.
open_leads: recover expansion meeting dates/minutes naming the minister
recover Ministry of Education routing/approval papers
recover Cabinet or OEC records showing Lee's position on requested scope expansion
